description: Role scopes for Sales Person Wise Sales Report.

fields.description: If a user has more than one of these roles, the broadest scope applies: See All, then Team, then Own Only. Administrator always sees every Sales Person. A role that is not listed cannot run Sales Person Wise Sales Report.
fields.label: Role Scope

fields.description: These roles see only the Sales Person linked to the logged-in user. Descendants are not included.
fields.label: Own Only Roles

fields.description: These roles see their linked Sales Person plus every descendant in the Sales Person tree on this site.
fields.label: Team Roles

fields.description: These roles see every Sales Person. Sales Manager is not in this list by default.
fields.label: See All Roles

name: Sales Reports Settings
